title: Bigoli Italian Breakfast
description: A hearty Italian-inspired breakfast featuring bigoli pasta, eggs, and Italian seasonings.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the bigoli pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Crack in the eggs and scramble until cooked through.
Add the cooked bigoli pasta to the skillet with the eggs.
Stir in the Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Add the quenched tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine.
